title_how: Powered pods at hub towers, leased per kW

flow.detail: Screen aggregation towers for fiber, grid power and land; SBA has pre-qualified 8,000 US towers for edge
Factory-built 250-1,000 kW powered shells: space, power, cooling-ready, fiber entry and security
Anchor carrier pools AI-RAN/vRAN baseband; inference, CDN and enterprise tenants fill the rest
Neutral cross-connects between tenants and fiber; tenants own GPUs, towerco owns the shell

payers.pays_for: Per-kW space and power to pool AI-RAN/vRAN baseband near cell clusters
Low-latency powered racks for distributed inference ('AI grid' nodes)
Edge cache and peering points closer to users, plus cross-connect fees
Local compute for video analytics, robotics and sovereign data workloads

title_market: AI-RAN and edge compute pull power to the cell edge

stats.label: Cumulative AI-RAN market opportunity expected by 2030
Global edge data center market by 2030, up from US$15.4B in 2024 (17.1% CAGR)
First commercial Nokia AI-RAN deployments on Nvidia; trials 2026, scale availability 2028

unit_economics.note: Illustrative: power pass-through excluded; 10-yr anchor lease; tenant owns IT and GPUs; ramp to 80% over 3 years.

title_plan: Proven by peers; ramp ahead of the 6G cycle

precedents.name: American Tower edge data centers
precedents.what: Raleigh RA1 at tower base: 1 MW at launch, up to 4 MW; 1,000+ ATC sites deemed feasible for multi-MW edge

precedents.name: SBA Edge (SBA Communications)
precedents.what: Shelter-style edge sites at towers (e.g., Arlington, TX); 40-50 sites live or in development by 2023

precedents.name: Vapor IO + Crown Castle
precedents.what: Kinetic Edge micro data centers at tower bases, Chicago first; Crown Castle took a minority stake

plan.milestones: 5-10 US hub pods with one carrier AI-RAN anchor plus a CDN or inference tenant; standard pod design and per-kW contract
100+ pods in top metros; 2+ paying tenant types per pod; 5-10 yr leases; interconnection product live
Replicate in Brazil and Central America; MW-class hubs at selected sites aligned to 6G and AI grid rollouts
